name: Hungaroring
summary: Monaco without the walls: tight, twisty and hot, with almost nowhere to pass.
character: Slow corners one after another, so teams bring maximum downforce. It's dusty off the racing line, often very hot, and hard to overtake on, so strategy and qualifying decide a lot.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.note: Downhill right at the end of the main straight. The main chance to overtake.

corners.name: Turn 4
corners.note: A fast, blind left over a crest. Easy in a good car, scary in a bad one.

moments.title: Hill nearly wins in an Arrows
moments.body: Reigning champion Damon Hill led most of the 1997 race in a usually slow Arrows. A hydraulic problem slowed him in the closing laps, and Jacques Villeneuve passed him on the last lap. Hill finished second.

history.body: First F1 race behind the Iron Curtain.
Lengthened to 4.381 km, with a longer main straight.
Jenson Button's first win, in the wet.
